page_title: MET 2-2 MAR | Metz v Marseille 18/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The match has just finished.
90+7' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Alexandre Oukidja (Metz) is given a yellow card.

90+6' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the bottom left corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Alexandre Oukidja, who pulls off a stunning save!
90+5' Amine Harit (Marseille) takes a wild swing at a rebound from mid-range and it goes well wide of the right post.
90+5' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
90+2' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Koffi Kouao (Metz) comes onto the pitch so that Malick Mbaye can be given a rest.
90+1' Malick Mbaye (Metz) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
90' We will have 9 min. of added time.
90' Jerome Brisard rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Malick Mbaye (Metz).
89' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
89' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle as Lamine Camara (Metz) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
88' Marseille take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
86' A quickly taken corner by Marseille.
85' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
85' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Marseille.
84' Substitution. Habib Maiga (Metz) replaces Cheikh Sabaly.
84' Laszlo Boloni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Benjamin Tetteh (Metz) replacing Georges Mikautadze.
82' 2 - 2 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Vitinha (Marseille) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom right corner. Good team effort!
81' A great solo run by Georges Mikautadze (Metz) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the left side of the goal was easily caught by Pau Lopez.
80' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jordan Veretout (Marseille).
80' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

79' Chancel Mbemba (Marseille) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from near the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the left post!
78' Malick Mbaye (Metz) is penalised for holding. Jerome Brisard signals a set piece.
77' Marseille take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
77' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Marseille.
76' It will be a substitution. Francois Regis Mughe (Marseille) is ready to enter the pitch as Iliman Ndiaye walks off.
75' Marcelino has decided to make a change. Vitinha (Marseille) replaces Leonardo Balerdi.
71' 2 - 1 Goal! Georges Mikautadze (Metz) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 2:1.
70' The corner is swung in but Metz can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
69' Marseille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
68' Marseille take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
68' An attempted cross from Renan Lodi (Marseille) is cleared.
67' Substitution. Emran Soglo makes his way off the pitch and Amine Harit (Marseille) comes on as his replacement.
67' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Marseille comes to nothing.
65' Goal! Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) shoots from distance and his effort takes a nick off the defender and goes past Pau Lopez. 1:1.
64' Kevin N'Doram (Metz) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

63' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jerome Brisard with no other option than to blow for a foul.
62' Here is a change. Youssef Maziz is going off and Laszlo Boloni gives the last tactical orders to Lamine Camara (Metz).
59' Ababacar Moustapha Lo (Metz) is shown a red card by the referee for chasing his opponent and bringing him down with a very nasty tackle!
57' Wasted opportunity. Kevin N'Doram (Metz) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post.
56' It is time for a substitution. Jordan Veretout (Marseille) is on for Geoffrey Kondogbia.
54' Having seen unsporting behavior, Jerome Brisard shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Laszlo Boloni (Metz) is the recipient.
53' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Marseille due to a foul in the build-up play.
53' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible foul. The Marseille players aren’t happy.
52' Valentin Rongier (Marseille) leaps to meet an excellent cross and steers a fantastic header past the goalkeeper, inside the left post.
51' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
50' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) commits a rough foul. Jerome Brisard stops the game and makes a call.
50' Ababacar Moustapha Lo (Metz) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jerome Brisard blows for a foul.
49' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Renan Lodi (Marseille) was quite harsh and Jerome Brisard didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

48' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Pau Lopez pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
46' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Jerome Brisard has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' The Marseilleplayers are livid after referee Jerome Brisard signals NO GOAL after the VAR review!
45+2' Marseille score a goal, but the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
45+1' A goal, which was scored by Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille), was disallowed due to offside.
45+1' That's a well-taken pass by Georges Mikautadze (Metz). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' Renan Lodi (Marseille) attempts to score from a mid-range free kick, but he curls his effort a few inches over the crossbar.
43' Marseille are awarded a mid-range free kick.
42' Fali Cande (Metz) was too forceful with his tackle and Jerome Brisard interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
40' Metz have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

40' Pau Lopez makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Fali Cande (Metz) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the top left corner. Metz have been awarded a corner kick.
38' Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
34' Emran Soglo (Marseille) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
34' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle and signals a foul after Renan Lodi (Marseille) brought his opponent down.
32' Good movement by Renan Lodi (Marseille), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
32' Emran Soglo (Marseille) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
30' A pass by Malick Mbaye (Metz) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
30' The resulting set piece from Metz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
29' Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jerome Brisard blows for a foul.
28' Malick Mbaye (Metz) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
27' Metz control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

23' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
22' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
20' Malick Mbaye (Metz) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
20' Metz can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
18' Emran Soglo (Marseille) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alexandre Oukidja, who smothers the ball.
17' A pass by Kevin N'Doram (Metz) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
14' 0 - 1 Emran Soglo (Marseille) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and fires into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
9' Kevin N'Doram (Metz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jerome Brisard had an easy-decision to make.
8' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Renan Lodi (Marseille). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

7' Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the left side of the goal, but is thwarted by a great save from Alexandre Oukidja. The ball is out of play. Marseille will have a chance to score from a corner.

6' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
4' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle. Fali Cande (Metz) commits a foul after dangerous play.
2' Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies onto the right post!
2' Neat passing move from Marseille in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Marseille will kick-off.
Jerome Brisard will supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
